scope: real VM fault localization followed by source fix and arithmetic tests; no successful guest boot claimed
cause: Non-monitor ARM_LARGE_MEMORY reserved only real_phys_size bytes of virtual aperture, but block-congruent physmap entries insert alignment holes after the randomized 16-KiB base.
fix: VZ-only reserve PTOV_TABLE_SIZE * ARM_TT_TWIG_SIZE extra virtual space and account for it in the initial L1 reservation. Physical RAM size, random slide and final assertion are unchanged; arithmetic overflow and overlap are rejected.
